destinations.name: Rome & the Vatican
destinations.intro: Three days of landmarks, neighbourhood walks and Roman food. These ideas sit around your existing bookings.

recommendations.title: The Pantheon
recommendations.description: Look up through the great dome to its open oculus.
recommendations.tip: Keep your booked entry; enjoy Piazza della Rotonda before or afterward.

recommendations.title: Piazza Navona
recommendations.description: A lively square framed by fountains and Baroque buildings.
recommendations.tip: An optional wander around your Pantheon visit; skip it if you need a rest.

recommendations.title: The Colosseum
recommendations.description: Your guided visit puts the amphitheatre and its arena into context.
recommendations.tip: Use the entrance and meeting instructions on your actual tour booking.

recommendations.title: Roman Forum & Palatine Hill
recommendations.description: Walk among the remains of ancient Rome, then take in the hilltop views.
recommendations.tip: Follow your ticket conditions and pace the visit around your planned breaks.

recommendations.title: Vatican Museums & St Peter’s
recommendations.description: Your guided day combines the Vatican collections and the basilica area.
recommendations.tip: Follow the booked tour route; allow for security and dress requirements.

recommendations.title: Spanish Steps
recommendations.description: Take in the staircase and Piazza di Spagna on your afternoon walk.
recommendations.tip: Keep this flexible after the Vatican tour and your hotel rest.

recommendations.title: Trevi Fountain
recommendations.description: See the dramatic fountain from the surrounding piazza.
recommendations.tip: Keep belongings close in the crowd and follow the posted access rules.

recommendations.title: Pasta alla carbonara
recommendations.description: A Roman pasta classic with egg, pecorino, guanciale and black pepper.
recommendations.tip: Ask what pasta dishes are on today’s menu rather than assuming a fixed offering.
recommendations.mapsQuery: La Taverna dei Fori Imperiali Via della Madonna dei Monti 9 Roma
recommendations.venue: Your existing dinner stop: La Taverna dei Fori Imperiali.

recommendations.title: Supplì
recommendations.description: A crisp fried rice snack, often with a melting mozzarella centre.
recommendations.tip: A small snack works well between sightseeing stops; fillings can vary.
recommendations.venue: Browse at your planned Mercato Centrale or Monti food stop.

recommendations.title: Maritozzo con la panna
recommendations.description: A soft sweet bun filled with whipped cream.
recommendations.tip: Ask for one to share if you want a lighter pastry break.
recommendations.venue: Look at the pastry counters around your planned Mercato Trionfale visit.

recommendations.title: Caffè espresso
recommendations.description: A small coffee makes an easy pause between walks.
recommendations.tip: “Un caffè, per favore.” Ask the price before choosing counter or table service.
recommendations.venue: Optional café near the Pantheon: Sant’Eustachio Il Caffè.

recommendations.title: Frascati white wine
recommendations.description: A wine from the hills outside Rome.
recommendations.tip: Ask whether Frascati is available by the glass with your dinner.
recommendations.mapsQuery: La Taverna dei Fori Imperiali Roma
recommendations.venue: Ask at your existing dinner stop; wine lists change.

destinations.name: Naples
destinations.intro: A transfer stop, with optional quick tastes if your station-to-port timing allows. Ferry and train departures come first.

recommendations.title: Castel Nuovo exterior
recommendations.description: The castle is a memorable landmark in the port district.
recommendations.tip: Only a short exterior look if your transfer has spare time; keep the ferry first.

recommendations.title: Piazza Municipio
recommendations.description: A central square near the castle and waterfront.
recommendations.tip: Use this as transfer context, not an added timed sightseeing stop.

recommendations.title: Neapolitan pizza
recommendations.description: A simple margherita is a good introduction to Naples’ pizza.
recommendations.tip: If time is tight, ask for takeaway; a sit-down meal may not fit the transfer.
recommendations.venue: Choose a counter near your station or port route after checking the queue.

recommendations.title: Sfogliatella
recommendations.description: Choose the flaky riccia or the smoother shortcrust frolla.
recommendations.tip: Ask which pastries are ready and keep an eye on your departure time.
recommendations.mapsQuery: Antico Forno delle Sfogliatelle Calde Attanasio Napoli
recommendations.venue: Optional near-station stop: Attanasio. Queue length may rule it out.

recommendations.title: A Neapolitan coffee break
recommendations.description: An espresso is a compact way to pause during the transfer.
recommendations.tip: Order at a café along the route rather than making a separate detour.

recommendations.title: A Campanian white wine
recommendations.description: Ask for a local white by the glass if you have a relaxed meal.
recommendations.tip: Save this for a comfortable meal window; you do not need to fit it into the transfer.
recommendations.venue: Ask the venue what local wines are available.

destinations.name: Sorrento
destinations.intro: Your base for three nights: town views, an easy stroll and lemon flavours around the places you already planned.

recommendations.title: Villa Comunale views
recommendations.description: A garden viewpoint over the Bay of Naples.
recommendations.tip: This is already in your itinerary; pause here before the food and lemon-garden stops.
recommendations.photoLabel: View from the Villa Comunale terrace

recommendations.title: San Francesco cloister
recommendations.description: A peaceful cloister beside the town’s public gardens.
recommendations.tip: Add it to the same stroll if open; respect ceremonies or private events.

recommendations.title: Piazza Tasso
recommendations.description: The central square is a useful starting point for an old-town wander.
recommendations.tip: Your October 4 evening already brings you here; keep market details subject to local signs.

recommendations.title: Gnocchi alla sorrentina
recommendations.description: Gnocchi with tomato, basil and melting cheese.
recommendations.tip: Ask whether it is on the menu at dinner; it is a filling choice after a day of walking.
recommendations.venue: Your planned dinner option: Annaré. Check the current menu.

recommendations.title: Delizia al limone
recommendations.description: A soft lemon dessert associated with the Sorrento peninsula.
recommendations.tip: Ask whether the version contains liqueur if you prefer to avoid alcohol.
recommendations.venue: Look for it in a central pasticceria; the photograph is representative.

recommendations.title: Limoncello
recommendations.description: A lemon liqueur closely associated with this coast.
recommendations.tip: Try a small serving after food; this is a liqueur, not lemonade.
recommendations.mapsQuery: I Giardini di Cataldo Via Correale 27 Sorrento
recommendations.venue: Already on your itinerary: I Giardini di Cataldo.

recommendations.title: Limonata
recommendations.description: An alcohol-free lemon drink for a walking break.
recommendations.tip: Ask whether it is fresh or bottled and how sweet it is.
recommendations.venue: Ask a café on your existing town walk.

destinations.name: Pompeii
destinations.intro: Choose a manageable route through the ruins, then keep your Caupona reservation and rental-car return time.

recommendations.title: The Forum
recommendations.description: Start with the open civic centre to orient yourself within the ancient city.
recommendations.tip: Use the park’s current map and follow the route that suits your entry gate.

recommendations.title: The theatre district
recommendations.description: The ancient performance spaces offer a different view of everyday Roman life.
recommendations.tip: Check the current accessible route and openings in the park’s free guide.

recommendations.title: Stabian Baths
recommendations.description: An ancient bathing complex with distinct rooms and water systems.
recommendations.tip: Visit if open on the day; individual buildings can close independently of the park.

recommendations.title: Insalata caprese
recommendations.description: Tomatoes, mozzarella and basil make a simple meal option.
recommendations.tip: Ask what is available before your park visit; carry your planned snacks and water.
recommendations.venue: Choose a nearby lunch stop if needed. Your Caupona dinner reservation stays unchanged.

recommendations.title: Pastiera
recommendations.description: A Campanian pastry traditionally made with ricotta and cooked wheat.
recommendations.tip: Ask a pasticceria if it is available; a slice is an optional treat rather than a promised menu item.

recommendations.title: Caffè after the ruins
recommendations.description: A small coffee can round off your break after the park.
recommendations.tip: At Caupona, choose from the actual October menu; the advertised special menus have seasonal dates.
recommendations.venue: Your booked dinner: Caupona. Confirm menu choices directly.

recommendations.title: Local wine — after driving
recommendations.description: Ask for a regional wine by the glass on an evening when you are finished driving.
recommendations.tip: You have a rental car this day: choose an alcohol-free drink until the car is returned.
recommendations.venue: Optional later in Sorrento, after the rental-car return.

destinations.name: Positano
destinations.intro: About one hour with the group tour: choose a short walk or a quick taste, and confirm where to meet again.

recommendations.title: Santa Maria Assunta
recommendations.description: The church and its colourful dome are a focal point of Positano.
recommendations.tip: Keep the one-hour tour stop compact; ask your guide about the walk back to the meeting point.

recommendations.title: Spiaggia Grande views
recommendations.description: Look back from the waterfront toward the hillside houses.
recommendations.tip: Enjoy the view if it fits the guide’s route; allow for the uphill return.

recommendations.title: Seafood salad
recommendations.description: A coastal seafood dish often dressed with lemon.
recommendations.tip: A seated meal may exceed the stop; ask how long service will take before ordering.
recommendations.mapsQuery: La Zagara Via dei Mulini 10 Positano
recommendations.venue: La Zagara is a central food stop; confirm the day’s savoury menu.

recommendations.title: Delizia al limone
recommendations.description: A lemon pastry is an easy way to taste the coast.
recommendations.tip: For a short stop, ask for a ready pastry to take away; check for liqueur if avoiding alcohol.
recommendations.mapsQuery: La Zagara Via dei Mulini 10 Positano
recommendations.venue: La Zagara lists delizia al limone among its pastries.

recommendations.title: Limonata
recommendations.description: A refreshing alcohol-free choice between the lanes and waterfront.
recommendations.tip: Ask for a lemon drink to go if the tour meeting time is close.
recommendations.mapsQuery: La Zagara Via dei Mulini 10 Positano
recommendations.venue: Ask at a café on your walking route; drink offerings vary.

recommendations.title: A small limoncello
recommendations.description: A lemon liqueur to sample with a relaxed food break.
recommendations.tip: Keep the tour schedule first; skipping a tasting leaves more time for the view.
recommendations.venue: Ask a central café whether it serves local limoncello.

destinations.name: Amalfi
destinations.intro: About one hour: the cathedral square, a waterfront look and a ready pastry are the most compact choices.

recommendations.title: Cathedral of Sant’Andrea
recommendations.description: The cathedral façade and steps dominate the main square.
recommendations.tip: With one hour in town, start outside; enter only if the opening and queue fit.

recommendations.title: The waterfront
recommendations.description: Take in the harbour and the town rising behind it.
recommendations.tip: Stay within the guide’s suggested area and keep the return meeting time visible.

recommendations.title: Scialatielli ai frutti di mare
recommendations.description: A coastal pasta choice with seafood.
recommendations.tip: This needs a meal window; do not squeeze a full lunch into the one-hour stop.
recommendations.photoLabel: Fresh scialatielli before cooking — representative pasta photo

recommendations.title: Lemon pastries
recommendations.description: Citrus pastries are a convenient taste of Amalfi.
recommendations.tip: Choose a ready pastry and ask about its ingredients and any liqueur.
recommendations.venue: Pansa sits on Piazza Duomo, beside the cathedral.

recommendations.title: Granita di limone
recommendations.description: An icy lemon treat for a quick refreshment.
recommendations.tip: Ask whether granita is available that day; it works better with a short stop than a long meal.
recommendations.venue: Pansa describes using lemons from its family estate for its granita.

recommendations.title: Amalfi limoncello
recommendations.description: A local lemon liqueur, usually taken in a small serving.
recommendations.tip: Ask about the producer and take time to sip; a tasting is optional on this short visit.
recommendations.venue: Ask a central bar or shop what is available.

destinations.name: Ravello
destinations.intro: About two hours: make the gardens your main stop, with time for the piazza and a café if the tour schedule permits.

recommendations.title: Villa Rufolo
recommendations.description: Gardens and terraces make this a natural focus for your Ravello stop.
recommendations.tip: Use the two-hour visit for one main garden and a café break; check admission on arrival.

recommendations.title: Piazza Duomo & cathedral
recommendations.description: Enjoy the central square around the cathedral and Villa Rufolo entrance.
recommendations.tip: Keep your coffee stop close to the centre so the return to the tour is straightforward.

recommendations.title: Torta caprese
recommendations.description: A chocolate-and-almond cake from the Campanian pastry tradition.
recommendations.tip: Ask what cake is available at the café; this is a regional suggestion, not a fixed menu promise.
recommendations.venue: Central café option: Caffè Calce.

recommendations.title: A slice of pastiera
recommendations.description: A ricotta-and-wheat pastry to look for in local pastry cases.
recommendations.tip: Availability varies outside holiday periods; choose a ready local pastry if it is not on offer.
recommendations.venue: Browse the pastry selection at Caffè Calce or another central café.

recommendations.title: Espresso in the piazza
recommendations.description: A short café stop leaves time for the gardens and views.
recommendations.tip: Ask for “un caffè” and check the table-service price before sitting down.
recommendations.venue: Caffè Calce is a central coffee option.

recommendations.title: A local white wine
recommendations.description: Ask for a Campanian white with a relaxed food break.
recommendations.tip: A small glass is optional; keep the tour meeting time in mind.
recommendations.venue: Ask what regional wine is available rather than expecting a particular label.
